title: CVE-2026-116779 added to CISA KEV (exploited in the wild)
summary_en: SignalWire FreeSwitch contains a code injection vulnerability that permits configuration and credential disclosure, arbitrary call control, and command execution.
lines: SignalWire FreeSwitch: SignalWire FreeSwitch Code Injection Vulnerability
SignalWire FreeSwitch contains a code injection vulnerability that permits configuration and credential disclosure, arbitrary call control, and command execution.
